messages:
maya: Heads-up: starting canary deploy of rwd-inference v1.12.2 to prod in ~10m. Canary target = fleet-2 (us-west). Rolling window 15m. @kevin @sophie please monitor p95, 5xx, and kv cache hit. Quick checklist below:

```
- canary -> fleet-2 (us-west)
- 10m stabilize -> metrics check at +5m and +12m
- smoke/run: ./scripts/smoke_canary.sh --url https://api.redwood/prod/canary
- rollback trigger: agg_5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 400ms for 3m
```

kevin: On it. I'll run smoke script at start and at +10m. Will post results.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment kicked by maya at 1779991290. status: INIT.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created temp dashboard 'canary/v1.12.2/us-west' and alert group 'canary-watch'.

kevin: smoke run 1 results: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood/prod/canary` -> `200 0.12` x5, no 5xx. p95 ~ 120ms. kv_hit=0.86. Outputs: 

```
200 0.12
200 0.13
200 0.11
200 0.14
200 0.12
summary: p95=140ms, errors=0, kv_hit=86%
```

maya: Noted. I'm increasing traffic to 10% (canary) now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic weight -> canary=10% at 1779991330

sophie: Dashboards: slight CPU bump on replica-1 but healthy. Alert thresholds set, will page if anything > threshold. Also seeing a small 5xx blip at 1779991342 (5 errors in 1m) — investigating logs.

kevin: Checked logs: stack traces in inference-worker for an edge case with empty prompt. Quick patch ready: https://git.redwood/patches/123 but not rolling yet. Blip seems isolated to one host.

dave: If blip persists, ready to hit rollback. Rollback steps in runbook: ./ops/rollback_canary.sh v1.12.1 — I've tested locally.

maya: Keeping canary for another 10m. Kevin, Sophie — if blip resurfaces > 3m, rollback. Otherwise we'll proceed to 50%.

kevin: Running another smoke at +8m. FYI lowered batch-size on canary replicas by 10% to reduce tail latency.

kevin: run2 results:

```
run2: 200 0.13
200 0.12
502 0.05
200 0.11
200 0.13
summary: p95=160ms, errors=1(502), kv_hit=85%
```

sophie: That single 502 appears tied to the empty-prompt handler. Patch would fix. Ops agreed we can let this canary continue if error rate <=0.2% and no sustained p95 > 400ms. Current error rate << threshold.

maya: Okay moving to 50% canary in 5m if green. Tagging @dave for rollback stand-by.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: weight -> canary=50% at 1779991402

kevin: Monitoring now. No new errors in the last 3m. p95 stable ~150ms.

sophie: Alerts quiet. Memory/heap stable. Will post final thumbs in 10m.

maya: Alright — proceeding to full deploy at the end of the window. If anyone sees anomalous trend, call rollback and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks team :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary finished, proceeding to ramp to 100% at 1779991459

kevin: Final: all green. 0.03% error, p95 155ms, kv_hit 84%.

sophie: Ack. Closing dashboard, archiving temporary alerts.

dave: Rollback not needed. Good job.
